changes.current_line: Recover failed payments automatically with smart retries.
changes.change: For buyers who report member churn to their board: 'Win back the members who never meant to leave.' Send us one month of your failed renewals and we will show which ones usually come back with a retry or an updated card, so you can see what is recoverable inside the churn number you already report.
changes.why: The deal started when the customer split board-reported churn into cancellations and failed cards and described the second group as 'members who never meant to leave', and it was the recovery analysis on their own failed renewals that landed.

changes.change: Add a finance-approver proof step before the contract goes out: a recovery analysis on the prospect's own failed renewals, delivered as a spreadsheet finance can keep, together with a plain model of exit costs and contract term. Aim it at the controller or finance approver, not only the champion.
changes.why: The controller had been silent for two meetings and held the paper for two weeks, asked for the spreadsheet, asked about termination fees twice, and signed four days after the data session.

changes.current_line: Online and in-store on one platform; the line between them has pretty much disappeared.
changes.change: Stop leading with the one-platform claim for studio buyers whose front desk would run through a partner integration, until we can demo the reader live inside their studio software. Until then, position online membership billing and recovery as phase one.
changes.why: The line was heard as hardware ('is that the readers?'), the customer asked to see our reader inside their studio software, we could not show it live, and the studio phase still has no date because it depends on the partner piece.

changes.current_line: Financial infrastructure to grow globally, in every currency.
changes.change: Do not open with the global slide for multi-site operators in one or two countries, like this US and Canada studio operator. Open instead with the recovery analysis on their own failed renewals.
changes.why: The rep opened with the global slide and got 'Silence.' from a customer with studios in the US and a handful in Canada, while the analysis on their own failed renewals is what moved the deal.
